purpose: Define the first league-agnostic FSFFL-native projection challenger. The model forecasts underlying football stat components first; fantasy scoring is applied later by league configuration.

team_context_policy.purpose: Capture material changes in opportunity caused by playcalling, scheme, pace, personnel allocation, and expected game script without hard-coding coach-name adjustments.
team_context_policy.shrinkage_rule: Historical coach/playcaller tendencies must be shrunk toward league average when sample size is limited so one unusual personnel-driven season is not treated as permanent philosophy.
team_context_policy.anti_leakage_rule: For a target season, use only team-strength, coaching, personnel, and tendency information genuinely available before that season. Realized target-season wins, scoring margin, EPA, pass rate, or usage are prohibited as training features for that same forecast.
team_context_policy.promotion_rule: A team/coaching feature is retained only if it materially improves rolling temporal holdouts, uncertainty calibration, or an important projection component. Football plausibility alone is not sufficient.

v1_training_policy.holdout: latest season, with all earlier seasons used for training; rolling-origin holdouts required before production promotion
v1_training_policy.promotion_rule: Do not replace production projections unless held-out evidence is materially better or comparably accurate with meaningfully lower dependency/complexity.

data_rights.rule: Verify the license of each dataset actually ingested; do not assume every nflverse-served dataset has identical licensing.
